cards.target: Bisognerebbe fare attenzione.
cards.english: One should be careful.

cards.target: Da solo, non riuscirei.
cards.english: Alone, I wouldn't manage.

cards.target: Comprerei quella casa.
cards.english: I would buy that house.

cards.target: Mangerei volentieri una pizza.
cards.english: I would gladly eat a pizza.

cards.target: Secondo le previsioni, neverebbe.
cards.english: According to the forecast, it would snow.

cards.target: Se avesse più coraggio, parlerebbe.
cards.english: If he had more courage, he'd speak up.

cards.target: Sicuramente, accetterei quell'offerta di lavoro.
cards.english: I'd definitely accept that job offer.

cards.target: Saranno partiti senza di noi.
cards.english: They must have left without us.

cards.target: Saranno usciti senza dirci niente.
cards.english: They must have gone out without telling us.

cards.target: Avrei voluto venire alla festa.
cards.english: I would have liked to come to the party.

cards.target: A loro piacerebbe viaggiare di più.
cards.english: They'd like to travel more.

cards.target: Non dovremmo giudicare le persone dall'aspetto.
cards.english: We shouldn't judge people by their appearance.

cards.target: Marco troverà sicuramente un buon lavoro.
cards.english: Marco will definitely find a good job.

cards.target: Il tempo migliorerà nel fine settimana.
cards.english: The weather will improve on the weekend.

cards.target: Potrei venire alla festa sabato sera.
cards.english: I could come to the party Saturday night.

cards.target: Gradirei ricevere maggiori informazioni sul corso.
cards.english: I'd appreciate receiving more information about the course.

cards.target: Dove andresti se potessi vivere ovunque?
cards.english: Where would you go if you could live anywhere?

cards.target: Lei inizierà un nuovo corso di lingue.
cards.english: She'll start a new language course.

cards.target: Prima di decidere, ci penserei su bene.
cards.english: Before deciding, I'd think it over carefully.

cards.target: Rimarrei a Roma per sempre se potessi.
cards.english: I'd stay in Rome forever if I could.

cards.target: Torneresti a vivere con i tuoi genitori?
cards.english: Would you go back to living with your parents?

cards.target: Bastava che tu mi avvisassi in anticipo.
cards.english: You just needed to let me know in advance.

cards.target: Uscirebbero più spesso se non piovesse sempre.
cards.english: They'd go out more often if it didn't always rain.

cards.target: Avevo cercato quel libro dappertutto senza trovarlo.
cards.english: I had looked for that book everywhere without finding it.

cards.target: Sarebbe bello fare una gita al lago.
cards.english: It would be nice to take a trip to the lake.

cards.target: Non sapevo che il tuo compleanno fosse oggi.
cards.english: I didn't know your birthday was today.

cards.target: Hai letto il messaggio che ti ho mandato?
cards.english: Did you read the message I sent you?

cards.target: Dovresti parlare con il tuo capo di questo.
cards.english: You should talk to your boss about this.

cards.target: Potremmo fissare un appuntamento per la prossima settimana?
cards.english: Could we schedule an appointment for next week?

cards.target: Si erano sposati tre anni prima di trasferirsi.
cards.english: They had gotten married three years before moving.

cards.target: Il nuovo ponte verrà inaugurato la prossima primavera.
cards.english: The new bridge will be inaugurated next spring.

cards.target: Il film che abbiamo visto ieri era bellissimo.
cards.english: The movie that we saw yesterday was beautiful.

cards.target: Porterò i bambini al parco dopo la scuola.
cards.english: I'll take the children to the park after school.

cards.target: Ci eravamo persi nel centro storico della città.
cards.english: We had gotten lost in the old town center.

cards.target: Quando sarà grande, vorrà viaggiare per il mondo.
cards.english: When she grows up, she'll want to travel the world.

cards.target: Sarebbe possibile avere un tavolo vicino alla finestra?
cards.english: Would it be possible to have a table by the window?

cards.target: Se dipendesse solo da me, vivremmo al mare.
cards.english: If it were only up to me, we'd live by the sea.

cards.target: Io non lo farei, ma è una tua scelta.
cards.english: I wouldn't do it, but it's your choice.

cards.target: La maggior parte delle persone preferirebbe lavorare da casa.
cards.english: Most people would prefer to work from home.

cards.target: Credevo che il negozio chiudesse più tardi il sabato.
cards.english: I thought the shop closed later on Saturday.

cards.target: Non sapevo che il tuo appartamento fosse così grande.
cards.english: I didn't know your apartment was so big.

cards.target: Fra poco inizierà lo spettacolo, cerchiamo i nostri posti.
cards.english: The show will start soon, let's find our seats.

cards.target: La casa dove abitava mia nonna era molto grande.
cards.english: The house where my grandmother lived was very big.

cards.target: La famiglia i cui figli vanno alla stessa scuola.
cards.english: The family whose children go to the same school.

cards.target: Se la macchina non fosse rotta, potremmo partire adesso.
cards.english: If the car weren't broken, we could leave now.

cards.target: Senza che nessuno se ne accorgesse, è uscito dalla stanza.
cards.english: Without anyone noticing, he left the room.

cards.target: La decisione grazie alla quale la mia vita è cambiata.
cards.english: The decision thanks to which my life changed.

cards.target: La riunione è durata tre ore, il che era troppo.
cards.english: The meeting lasted three hours, which was too much.

cards.target: Non crederei a quello che dice, se fossi in te.
cards.english: I wouldn't believe what he says, if I were you.

cards.target: La piazza dove si tiene il mercato il sabato mattina.
cards.english: The square where the market is held on Saturday morning.

cards.target: Un bicchiere di vino rosso starebbe bene con questo piatto.
cards.english: A glass of red wine would go well with this dish.

cards.target: Aveva sempre voluto imparare a suonare la chitarra da ragazzo.
cards.english: He had always wanted to learn to play guitar as a boy.

cards.target: La donna che vedo ogni mattina al bar è un'insegnante.
cards.english: The woman I see every morning at the bar is a teacher.

cards.target: Quando avrai letto questo libro, vorrai leggere anche il seguito.
cards.english: When you've read this book, you'll want to read the sequel too.

cards.target: L'insegnante ha detto agli studenti di aprire il libro a pagina dieci.
cards.english: The teacher told the students to open the book to page ten.

cards.target: Le dispiacerebbe chiudere la finestra?
cards.english: Would you mind closing the window?

cards.target: Probabilmente non accetterebbero queste condizioni.
cards.english: They probably wouldn't accept these conditions.

cards.target: Lavoreresti meno se potessi permettertelo?
cards.english: Would you work less if you could afford it?

cards.target: Si potrebbe migliorare il servizio clienti.
cards.english: Customer service could be improved.

cards.target: Ho scritto un messaggio a Marco.
cards.english: I wrote a message to Marco.

existing_tips: 'Lei' = she (or formal 'you'). Context determines which meaning. The verb form is the same for both.
Future after 'quando' where English uses present tense.
In spoken Italian, present tense often replaces future: 'Domani vado a Roma' = Tomorrow I'm going to
"Ciò che" / "quello che" = what/that which. Used when there is no specific antecedent.
Future of probability: avrà = 'he probably has'.
Futuro anteriore: sarò partito – with essere for movement verbs.
